pages.raw_text:
Asp.Net Core – True Ultimate Guide
Section 28 – Angular and CORS – Cheat Sheet
Angular
Angular is a TypeScript-based, free and open-source web application framework that is used to
create dynamic, single-page web applications that run on the browser.
CORS
CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) is a security feature implemented by web browsers to allow or
deny a web page from making requests to a different domain than the one that served the web
page.

pages.raw_text:
How CORS works?
Preflight Request
It is an HTTP OPTIONS request that is sent by the browser to the Web API server before the actual
request is made.
The preflight request is used to determine whether the Web API server is willing to accept the actual
request.
